## 80 Plus® Bronze Certification

HEXA 85+ , 80 PLUS ® Bronze certified, saves energy through its high efficiency up to 85%.

## DC to DC Module Design Provides Stable Power Outputs

HEXA 85+ is designed with DC-DC module which features good power conversion efficiency at 95% or better, excellent output voltage steadiness and magnetic amplifier’s ripple noise better than conventional ones.

## +12V Single Rail Design

Designed for power-intensive VGA cards, provides strong power to any overloading condition.

## High Quality Japanese E-capacitor

The high-quality Japanese E-capacitors can prolong product's life span by producing supreme stability and performance with low impedance characteristics.
